Snake Measurer 1.7.6 · 2026-09-18

A quiet but important update — about making sure nothing gets lost.

Sync you can trust. We found rare cases where a change from your phone could get lost on its way to the server. Now anything missing is re-sent automatically — including what got stuck before.

Signing out no longer erases quietly. If unsent entries are still on the device, the app asks first and offers to send them with one tap.

Numbers without the rounding. 1.23 m instead of 1.2 m, 4.05 ft instead of 4.0. The reference size shows exactly as you typed it.

And the small annoyances. The photo no longer disappears after clearing points and restarting, an interrupted edit no longer creates a duplicate, and the reminder asks for your attention at most once a day.
